title: Chapter 151 The Back Row Will Be Cut
content:
Chapter 151 The Back Row Will Be Cut

However, it is obvious that none of these spirit-eating powerhouses have moisture.

After swallowing so many resource fields, if there is any moisture, it would be a bit unreasonable.

So it has to be said that this Spirit-Eating Clan is the most difficult enemy they have ever faced.

"Awei, are you sure?"

Gu Chen said with a serious expression.

He was also very anxious when the back row was about to be cut. Of course, it was not just him, but everyone present was very anxious.

But this Spirit-Devouring Clan is really entangled. With its numerical advantage, it has dragged all their strong men.

Although it won’t be too long, those are six super-god realm powerhouses!

At the same time, the six spirit-eating powerhouses suddenly appeared not far away from Mu Yu, and then directly killed Mu Yu.

Seeing this scene, everyone on the battlefield suddenly felt their hearts in their throats.

bite!

A crisp sound rang out.

I saw countless light shields suddenly appear around Mu Yu.

Seeing this, everyone immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

However, before he could be happy, he heard a click, and the light shield suddenly cracked a gap.

It's a bit unstoppable.

Inside the light shield, Mu Yu also looked solemn.

My situation is not very good.

Looking at the battlefield, I saw that no one could free up his hand at this moment.

Even the most flexible An Xing was trapped by the extremely expensive secret technique used by the Spirit-Devouring Clan.

Is he going to sacrifice his life?

Thinking of this, Mu Yu was silent for a moment, then slowly closed his eyes.

The next moment, the staff in his hand began to buzz again.

At the same time, the buff blessing on the battlefield has become stronger and stronger.

As visible to the naked eye, Mu Yu's face gradually turned pale.

"Mu Yu, don't do stupid things!"

On the battlefield, Jian Xin suddenly shouted angrily.

The several powerful spirit-eating tribes facing Jian Xin looked extremely solemn.

Fighting at the same level, this woman is so strong that she almost suppresses them.

The opponent's sword is too sharp.

But even so, they still have to stand in front of this woman.

"Don't think about it, that woman is dead."

A powerful spirit-eating man showed his cold teeth and sneered.

Hearing this, Jian Xin's face looked ferocious, "She wants something to do, I want your entire Spirit-Devouring Clan to be buried with you!"

"Hahahaha, it's up to you?"

Faced with Jian Xin's threat, no one of the Spirit-Devouring Clan took it seriously.

At this moment, the light shield around Mu Yu was about to be completely broken. Faced with this, Mu Yu looked at no fear.

What are you afraid of? You can only die at worst.

It’s just a pity that you can’t watch His Majesty completely destroy these Spirit-Devouring Clans with your own eyes.

boom!

Finally, the light shield shattered.

The six powerful spirit-eating tribes rushed towards Mu Yu without any hesitation.

"No!!"

Seeing this, Jian Xin shouted unwillingly.

With a bang, several spirit-eating tribes in front of him were directly shocked by the surging sword energy.

However, the next moment, it got wrapped around like a dog's skin plaster.

Damn it!

At this moment, a deafening blast sounded on the other side of the battlefield.

Then, a figure rushed out of the battlefield.

"Um?"

Seeing this scene, Shi Chen frowned in the distance, and then bounced his fingers.

A terrifying attack went straight towards the figure.

"Brother Gu, be careful!"

Everyone exclaimed.

Gu Chen turned his head and looked, and suddenly burst into cold sweat.

This strength. .

"I'll do it!"

Awei's voice sounded.

The next moment, Awei blocked Gu Chen directly and then slashed out with a knife.

Boom!

After a loud bang, the attack immediately dissipated into the void.

"What!"

"How is that possible!!"

Seeing Awei blocking his attack, Shichen immediately looked unbelievable.

I am in the ordinary realm.

In his eyes, a super god-level powerful man was really just a slightly larger crawler.

And now, the crawler in his eyes actually blocked his attack.

This made him doubt himself.

At this time, Awei breathed a sigh of relief.

The light of the knife in his hand gradually dimmed.

This knife was not the sword he usually used to kill the sky, but was rewarded by Lu Daosheng again by chance.

The benefits that Lu Daosheng gained are naturally unimaginable as the subordinate whom he trusts the most.

Just like this knife.

The power contained in it is equivalent to the full-strength attack of a powerful man in the mortal realm.

Just now, he used the power in this knife to repel Gu Chen and the enemy in front of him, and blocked the attack of Shi Chen.

At the same time, Gu Chen finally arrived at Mu Yu's side.

"Miss, I'll help you!"

boom!

Gu Chen directly activated his full strength and punched the six Spirit-Devouring Clan powerhouses.

Faced with Gu Chen's attack, the six Spirit-Devouring Clan's powerful men had a clear division of labor. Three of them turned around to block Gu Chen, while the other three continued to kill Mu Yu.

Bang bang!

Two muffled sounds rang out.

The three powerful spirit-eating tribes took several steps back.

Mu Yu retreated thousands of feet away from the void.

The staff in his hand was even more fragmented.

Puff ~

A mouthful of scarlet blood spurted out of his mouth.

Mu Yu's already pale face became even more dismal.

"God-Mu!"

Finally, several masters from the Wasteland City successfully escaped from the battlefield and immediately stood in front of Mu Yu.

And Jian Xin of the Divine Dynasty also came over with his sword.

"God-killing Slash!"

Buzz——

A sword beam filled with the aura of destruction and killing slashed out from Jian Xin's sword and went straight towards the three Soul-Devouring Clan warriors.

Boom!

The void was shattered, and the three Soul-Devouring Clan warriors were seriously injured by a sword.

The next moment, the three figures disappeared directly from the spot.

Facing the angry Jian Xin, they chose to retreat strategically.

The best time to kill Mu Yu had passed, and there was no chance now.

"God-Mu, are you okay?"

At this time, the strong man of the Divine Dynasty hurriedly greeted.

Mu Yu wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth and shook her head slightly.

"I won't die."

Fortunately, it was only a blow from three super-god realm warriors. If it was six, she would really be dead.

Then, Mu Yu looked at Gu Chen in the distance with a slightly grateful look.

Gu Chen also looked over and smiled back.

Boom!

At this moment, a terrifying breath suddenly surged out of the void in the distance.

Suddenly, all the people in the deserted city of the Divine Dynasty on the entire battlefield looked extremely ugly, and even breathing became difficult.

The source of the breath was Shi Chen of the Devouring Spirit Clan.

At this moment, Shi Chen looked at everyone with a ferocious face, and was obviously a little furious that Ah Wei could block his attack.

"You all, all will die!"

I saw that Shi Chen actually killed everyone directly.

That was a powerful person in the Mortal Realm.

No one present could stop Shi Chen.

"Let's go together!"

Facing Shi Chen, everyone did not choose to sit and wait for death, but urged all their strength.

Seeing that everyone still wanted to resist, Shi Chen immediately showed a mocking look.

"It seems that you don't understand what the power of the Mortal Realm is."

Boom!

Shi Chen urged his strength and punched out.

In just a moment, the void that was about to collapse completely turned into nothingness.

Is this the end?

"Do you think that this emperor can't do anything to you, the Soul Devouring Clan?"

At this moment, words as cold as a thousand-year-old black ice suddenly came from the depths of the void.

The next moment, the space cracked.

A woman dressed in a noble dragon robe and extremely cold and beautiful walked out slowly from it, and then stepped into the air.

With every step, the suffocating breath became more terrifying.

The Empress of the Divine Dynasty.

Yan Lingyun!

It was that familiar feeling of oppression again.

After countless years, Shi Chen thought that he would not be as helpless as he was back then when he saw Yan Lingyun again.

But until now, his trembling legs told him that this was the truth.

"My lord, what should I do?"

At this time, a Soul Devouring Clan strongman appeared beside Shi Chen and said in a trembling voice.

Hearing this, Shi Chen was stunned for a moment, then suddenly laughed.

As he laughed, his voice became louder and louder until it echoed throughout the void.

"Haha, hahahaha, ah hahahahaha."

Shi Chen's smile gradually became more and more crazy, and then he turned and walked away, dancing as he walked.

Seeing this scene, not only the strong man of the Soul Devouring Clan beside him was a little confused.

The people of the Divine Dynasty and the Desolate City also frowned.

Until, Yan Lingyun suddenly said coldly: "Do you think you can escape this disaster by pretending to be stupid?"
